Until DrivePerf is set to stay awake, drives may not start on their own. The Health Check will keep this on your list.

Samsung can put apps to sleep to save battery. When it does, drives don’t start on their own. Two settings fix it.
Keep DrivePerf awake on your Xiaomi
Xiaomi phones stop background apps to save battery. When that happens, drives don’t start on their own. Three settings fix it.
